verdict.rationale: Render documents environment variables (only as a doc title) and managed OIDC that issues short-lived, auto-rotated identity tokens in place of stored long-lived API keys. That covers part of the secrets story. It also isolates non-production environments from production and lets you define the whole architecture centrally in a single Blueprint YAML file. Missing for 10: any evidence of team-level access control or role-based permissions, details on centrally shared or grouped environment variables and secrets across services, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
